financialDefinitions.realizedPl: Actual payout minus actual debited stake for matching settled wagers, including nonrefunded void fees.
financialDefinitions.roi: Realized P/L divided by matching non-void settled stake; unavailable when denominator is zero or amounts are incomplete.
financialDefinitions.capital: Cash movements and transfers are never included as wager P/L. Sport filters never recalculate whole-account cash.
financialDefinitions.legacy: A missing stored sport is Unspecified regardless of event, player or market text.
